name: Veddige - Nösslinge
description: Veddige to Nösslinge. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Dricksvatten vid Veddige station: Drinking-water tap on the outside of the toilet at Veddige bus/train station.

Dricksvatten vid Dranstugan: Water tap at the red building by Dranstugan, activated by push button. Official Swedish/place data suggests year-round water, while other English wording implies summertime; verify before public guarantee.

Dricksvatten vid Nösslinge kyrka: Endpoint-area water source at the red service building outside Nösslinge church. Official text says about 1 km from Gällarpesjön shelter and about 500 m side trip for hikers coming from Åkulla.
notes: Preserve official 351-point MultiLineString geometry as-is, or allow a later non-authoritative densification/QA process for the 1.9 km max coordinate gap and inter-segment gaps.
Flag the official GPX desc 'Total: 8.6 km' in any future importer so it is not confused with section distance.

Timing note: No official section-specific hiking time found. The official Hallandsleden page and API provide distance and difficulty only. At Hallandsleden's general planning pace of about 4 km/hour, 28 km implies about 7 hours moving time, but this is not an official value and the red/hard grading reflects length, steep slopes, wet/stony paths and mixed road/forest trail.

facilities.name: Hållplats - Veddige Station
facilities.description: Official start/end stop for Veddige stages; bus and train stop. Hallandsleden states bus 616 and Viskadalsbanan service.

facilities.name: Toalett Veddige station
facilities.description: Year-round toilet at Veddige bus/train station, stated open 07:00-23:00; also has drinking water. Varberg municipality responsible.

facilities.name: Dricksvatten vid Veddige station
facilities.description: Drinking-water tap on the outside of the toilet at Veddige bus/train station.

facilities.name: Hemköp Veddige
facilities.description: Grocery store in central Veddige; official text says open 08:00-21:00 daily. Check opening hours before relying on it/use.

facilities.name: Kullagårdens Glutenfria Stenugnsbageri
facilities.description: Gluten-free stone-oven bakery/cafe near the trail. Operator page describes cafe, pizza and picnic-basket options. Check current opening hours before relying on it/use.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Dranstugan skogen
facilities.coordinateSource: Hallandsleden places API; Naturkartan corroborates nearby
facilities.description: Newer Dranstugan shelter for 4-5 adults with fireplace and wood store. Toilet, water and older shelter are a few hundred meters southwest along Hallandsleden toward Nösslinge; parking nearby. This was off current N4 but is on current N5 around route km 6.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Dranstugan stugan
facilities.description: Older Dranstugan shelter for 4-5 adults with fireplace, dry toilet and water tap on the adjacent red building. Water seasonality wording conflicts across official sources; import with verification/seasonal caveat.

facilities.name: Dricksvatten vid Dranstugan
facilities.description: Water tap at the red building by Dranstugan, activated by push button. Official Swedish/place data suggests year-round water, while other English wording implies summertime; Check before public guarantee.

facilities.name: Parkering Dranstugan / Kvarndalen area
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node; official text mentions nearby parking but no separate official parking record
facilities.description: Parking mapped near the Dranstugan/Kvarndalen facility cluster.

facilities.name: Skvaltkvarnar i Kvarndalen
facilities.description: Official route feature: seven preserved water mills in Kvarndalen. Visit Varberg/Kvarnadalen context says the area has preserved mills and information signs.

facilities.name: Rastplats Kvarnsten
facilities.description: Official rest place on the trail with a table made from an old millstone.

facilities.name: Mäshults Kurs och lägergård
facilities.description: Official nearby hostel/lodging with rooms, Wi-Fi and bathing/boating/fishing possibilities at lake Mäsen.

facilities.name: Stensträngar
facilities.description: Official on-route historic field-boundary feature: parallel stone rows from old narrow fields.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Gällarpesjön
facilities.description: Endpoint shelter/campsite at Gällarpesjön for 4-5 adults with fireplace and wood store. Nearby bathing site and fishing; fishing permit may be required. No drinking water at shelter. Do not import drinking water at this shelter; official water is at Nösslinge church.

facilities.name: Toalett Gällarpesjön
facilities.description: Toilet south/east of the shelter by the car parking area. Official text says there is also a small lakeside rest area, waste bins and recycling containers.

facilities.name: Hållplats Gällarp
facilities.description: Bus stop by Gällarpesjön and the trail; official text states bus line 661 from Varberg station.

facilities.name: Parkering Gällarpesjön
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan direction coordinate; OSM node corroborates
facilities.description: Parking adjacent to the Gällarpesjön shelter area; Naturkartan states toilet plus several grills/fireplaces with bench tables.

facilities.name: Dricksvatten vid Nösslinge kyrka
facilities.description: Endpoint-area water source at the red service building outside Nösslinge church. Official text says about 1 km from Gällarpesjön shelter and about 500 m side trip for hikers coming from Åkulla.

facilities.name: Nösslinge kyrka
facilities.description: Red wooden church near Stora Neten with medieval origins. Important as the landmark/service-building location for the off-route endpoint drinking water.
